h1.en: the LZ-80 High and Low Pressure Ceilings Mean: 65 m³/h beside the Pneumatics article
h1.zh: LZ-80的高压和低压上限是什么意思：对照「氣動力學」时，65 m³/h仍在原页

directAnswer.en: On the LZ-80 concrete pump, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists two ceilings rather than one output. High pressure is ≤ 65 m³/h and ≤ 35 MPa. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics.
directAnswer.zh: 在 LZ-80 混凝土泵上，河北品锦机械在邢台标出的是两档上限，而不是一个产量。高压为 ≤ 65 m³/h 和 ≤ 35 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics. The picture shows Pneumatics. On the LZ-80 concrete pump, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists two ceilings rather than one output. The page does not list a switching procedure. Lower shown pressure sits with the higher output cap. It does not say which lever, valve or speed selects a mode, and it does not give a time or a temperature. Those metres are shown on other concrete pumps.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics。画面是Pneumatics。在 LZ-80 混凝土泵上，河北品锦机械在邢台标出的是两档上限，而不是一个产量。发动机行是 256 kW（玉柴），它不是这两档上限。LZ-80 的料斗是 0.6 m³，骨料是 6 cm 及以下，它们是数字格，不要和高度行混在一起。

body.en: High pressure is ≤ 65 m³/h and ≤ 35 MPa. Delivery height on the same sheet says consult factory standard, so it is not a metre taken from another pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a third mode. Do not invent that sequence. The LZ-80 hopper is 0.6 m³ and aggregate is 6 cm and below, which are numeric entries and should not be confused with the height line.
body.zh: 高压为 ≤ 65 m³/h 和 ≤ 35 MPa。它没有说哪个手柄、阀门或转速用来选择模式，也没有给出时间或温度。

body.en: Low pressure is ≤ 95 m³/h and ≤ 22 MPa. The output entry and the pressure entry both say high pressure and low pressure. The engine line is 256 kW (Yuchai), which is not one of those ceilings. Questions about an unpublished step go to /en/contact/.
body.zh: 低压为 ≤ 95 m³/h 和 ≤ 22 MPa。未公布步骤的问题请发到 /zh/contact/。

body.en: The ≤ sign is part of each entry. Higher shown pressure sits with the lower output cap. The sheet names the ceilings. Do not fill consult factory standard with LZ-60's 300 m or Diesel 120's 500 m.
body.zh: 同一页的输送高度写咨询工厂标准，所以它不是从别的泵借来的米数。不要用 LZ-60 的 300 m 或柴油120的 500 m 去填“咨询工厂标准”。

question.en: On this row: Which output is the high-pressure cap?
question.zh: 高压档的产量上限是多少？

answer.en: ≤ 65 m³/h, shown with ≤ 35 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics.
answer.zh: ≤ 65 m³/h，和 ≤ 35 MPa 标出在一起。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Which output is the low-pressure cap?
question.zh: 低压档的产量上限是多少？

answer.en: ≤ 95 m³/h, shown with ≤ 22 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics.
answer.zh: ≤ 95 m³/h，和 ≤ 22 MPa 标出在一起。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does the page explain how to change mode?
question.zh: 页面说明如何切换模式吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the ceilings only. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械只标出了上限。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is the delivery height 300 m?
question.zh: 输送高度是 300 m 吗？

answer.en: No. The LZ-80 entry says consult factory standard. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics.
answer.zh: 不是。LZ-80 这一格写的是咨询工厂标准。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumatics画面里印出的数字。
